explanation: This unit tracks how strongly the agent is committed to choosing a2: it stays near 0-2 while the agent is choosing a1 (D2 at 0-1, except about 2-3 after a rare S2), sits around 3-5 when choosing a2 in the early or middle part of the episode, and climbs to 7-10 when choosing a2 late in the episode (trial 85 or later), most of all after a run of rewarded a2 trials. Within an a2 trial, GO is the peak (about the same as D1, or a few points higher if the previous trial was unrewarded) and D2 is about 1 point below GO after a common S2 but drops to 1-3 after a rare S1; D1 is lower after an unrewarded trial (about 2 early on, 5-7 late) than after a rewarded one.
